name: Verify mail sent in offline mode is sent once device comes online
description: Verify that when mail is composed and sent in offline mode, it gets sent automatically once device comes online
descriptionHtml: Verify that when mail is composed and sent in offline mode, it gets sent automatically once device comes online

steps.name: Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
User is logged in. Navigating UI to remove existing account for a clean start
Click on 'Switch Account' icon
Click on 'Manage accounts on this device'
Verify the email account is visible in Manage Accounts
Click on 'Remove Account' icon
Click on 'Remove' button in the dialog
Verify that the Login Screen is displayed
Verify that the Login Screen is displayed
Login to application with user: prodfrugaltest1@qaprod.flock.com
Verifying notifications dialog showed
Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
Verify Bring Emails Now Message
Click on Bring Emails Now Discard Button
Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Inbox title should be visible

testStage.description: Verify that when mail is composed and sent in offline mode, it gets sent automatically once device comes online

steps.name: 223 - Verify on sending mail in offline, mails should be sent once coming online
225 - Verify on sending mails in offline, mails should be seen in sent folder with queued message below the thread. The queued message should be removed once mail is sent
Disable internet on device
Click on compose button
Generate subject with timestamp
Send email to: prodfrugaltest1@qaprod.flock.com with subject: TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28
Set To field: prodfrugaltest1@qaprod.flock.com
Enter subject: TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28
Enter email body: This email was sent in offline mode

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: This email was sent in offline mode

steps.name: Click Send button

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: This email was sent in offline mode

steps.name: Verify email queued toast is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Email queued toast should be displayed when sending in offline mode

parameters.name: conditionName
parameters.value: Email queued toast should be displayed when sending in offline mode

steps.name: Navigate to menu section: SENT_MAIL
Search for email with subject 'TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28' and click it
Scroll to element inside list in down direction
ASSERTION: PASSED - Email should be present in Sent folder while offline

parameters.name: conditionName
parameters.value: Email should be present in Sent folder while offline

steps.name: Verify queued message in sent folder is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Queued message indicator should be displayed in sent folder

parameters.name: conditionName
parameters.value: Queued message indicator should be displayed in sent folder

steps.name: Search for email with subject 'TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28' and click it
Wait for element and click: By.xpath: //android.widget.TextView[@resource-id='email.titan_internal:id/subjectView' and contains(@text,'TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28')]
Verify queued message in message view is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Queued message indicator should be displayed in sent folder

parameters.name: conditionName
parameters.value: Queued message indicator should be displayed in sent folder

steps.name: Enable internet on device
Search for email with subject 'TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28' and click it
Wait for element and click: By.xpath: //android.widget.TextView[@resource-id='email.titan_internal:id/subjectView' and contains(@text,'TC-223-Offline-Send 13:54:28')]
Verify queued message in message view is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Queued message should be removed after email is sent is FALSE

parameters.name: conditionName
parameters.value: Queued message should be removed after email is sent

steps.name: Navigate to menu section: INBOX
ASSERTION: PASSED - Email should be received in Inbox after coming online

parameters.name: conditionName
parameters.value: Email should be received in Inbox after coming online
